standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a quasi-coherent module locally as the cokernel of a map between direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the start of the counted proof (source lines 1476-1486)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presentation whose map has to be turned into a matrix over the ring of sections of a neighbourhood.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the sections of a direct sum over a quasi-compact open, and the second construction of the module associated to a module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1497-1498, 1512 and 1526-1528) as pointers to lemmas of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the abstract map into a matrix of sections over a smaller neighbourhood and identifies the resulting sheaf with the given one.

core_obligations: Present the module: shrinking the space the proof writes the module as the cokernel of a map between direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf, and points out the obstruction, namely that such a map need not be given by a matrix because sections of a direct sum are not the direct sum of the sections (proof lines 1476-1490)

Finite reduction: choosing a quasi-compact neighbourhood of the point and using the description of sections of a direct sum over a quasi-compact open, the proof obtains a smaller open neighbourhood on which each of the relevant sections lies in a finite direct sum and is a finite sum of sections of the structure sheaf (proof lines 1492-1515)

Build the module and compare: the proof defines a module as the cokernel of the map of free modules over the ring of sections of that neighbourhood given by the resulting matrix, and observes that the associated sheaf has the same presentation as the restriction of the given module, hence agrees with it (proof lines 1517-1529)
proof_roadmap: 先在 x 的邻域上把 F 写成 ⊕_{j∈J}O_X → ⊕_{i∈I}O_X 的余核；困难在于该映射未必由矩阵给出（直和的整体截面 ≠ 截面的直和）。

取 x 的准紧邻域 E 与 U ⊂ E，用「准紧开集上直和的截面就是截面的直和」（lemma-section-direct-sum-quasi-compact / lemma-limits-colimits）把每个 s_j|_U 化成有限和 ∑_{i∈I_j} f_{ij}，于是该映射在 U 上由矩阵 (f_ij) 给出；取 M 为该矩阵给出的自由 Γ(U,O_U)-模映射的余核，则 F_M 与 F|_U 有相同展示，故同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a quasi-coherent module on a ringed space is locally, around a point with a fundamental system of quasi-compact neighbourhoods, the module associated to a module over the ring of sections of that neighbourhood (author lemma at source lines 1463-1473, label lemma-quasi-coherent-module). The proof (source lines 1475-1530) isolates the real difficulty, namely that a map between direct sums need not be given by a matrix over the ring of sections, and resolves it by passing to a quasi-compact neighbourhood on which the sections of the direct sums become finite sums, after which the map is a matrix and the resulting associated module has the same presentation as the given one (proof lines 1492-1529). The reduction of the presentation to a matrix over a quasi-compact neighbourhood is the content. H3.
